messages:
marta: Heads-up — telemetry shows the 'beta-2' cohort getting ~12% of traffic but conversion/latency skew vs control is way higher than expected. digging into router logs, looks like a subset of users are sticky to control even after session reset. :thinking:
jamie: can you paste the routing rule? is this coming from cookie affinity or header override?
marta: adding the rule we pushed last week:
```
match: path: /v2/generate/*
conditions:
  - header: X-Experiment -> value: beta-2
  - expr: (hash(request.session_id) % 100) < 20
actions:
  - route: beta-2
  - fallback: control
```
marta: but in the logs I see a lot of `X-Experiment` present and set to `control` coming from the edge (client-side lib). looks like header sources are fighting with cohort hash.
kai: if the SDK sets X-Experiment header and we also compute hash server-side, we need a precedence rule. currently we do "first-match wins" on header vs cohort which biases toward the header source.
jamie: agreed. that explains users who reconnected with an older client — header wins and overrides cohort. two approaches: 1) make cohort hash take precedence unless header explicitly says `opt-in: true`, 2) add a ttl to header-sourced assignment and prefer server hash after ttl expires.
oliver: also quota handling is weird: when beta arm reaches per-customer token quota, router falls back to control but we don't emit an assignment-change telemetry event. dashboards show sustained requests in control but no cohort-change metric — impossible to reconcile.
marta: yeah that's the core problem — silent fallbacks. we need an assignment-change event with tags: previous_arm, new_arm, reason (quota/failure/overload).
jamie: minimal change suggestion:
```json
{
  "assignment_precedence": ["server_cohort", "header", "session_cookie"],
  "emit_assignment_change": true
}
```
jamie: and a console UX tweak: show per-customer rollouts with a little pill that says "forced-by-header" or "calculated" so PMs can see why someone is in a cohort.
kai: +1. also we should avoid double-binding when both header and cookie exist. propose explicit resolution: if header present and not `x-experiment-source=manual`, treat as external override and tag it.
oliver: telemetry wise we need two new metrics: `assignment_change_count` and `assignment_change_reason_breakdown`. also surface on the canary dashboard a time-series of sticky-rate (percent of requests in same assignment across 24h).
marta: can we also add a small sampling trace emitted when assignment changes so we can debug per-user? just 1% sample of full debug payloads.
deploy-bot: deploy vrouter/2026-03-20T15:32 queued by jamie — will run canary after approvals.
jamie: i'll draft a small PR: router: add precedence param + emit events. infra: add assignment-change index in clickhouse. ux: nina/product, can you take the pill UI? (cc @nina)
marta: thanks — timeline? this is impacting a live A/B, want a hotfix in next week if possible.
kai: i'll own router change, can get a small opt-in flag behind `feature.assignment_precedence` roll out to prod next Wed.
oliver: i'll wire telemetry and dashboard tiles, need one sprint. but can push minimal metrics early.
jamie: thanks all. follow-up: jamie will open PR, kai will review router logic, oliver will stub metrics, marta will attach example user IDs with repro.
marta: dropping a couple of sample request ids: r_8f3a, r_9b1c, r_72d2 — seen sticky to control despite `session_id` flip.
kai: got them. starting debug now.
jamie: :thumbsup:
